cards.ex: I tried to remember his name, but I just drew a blank.
cards.exUz: Men uning ismini eslashga harakat qildim, lekin hech narsani eslay olmadim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida o'ylaganingizda hech narsani eslay olmaslik.

cards.ex: During the long lecture, I just switched off.
cards.exUz: Uzoq ma'ruzada men shunchaki eshitmay qo'ydim.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni yo'qotish, eshitmay qo'yish yoki qiziqmay qolish.

cards.ex: We can't lose sight of our main objective here.
cards.exUz: Biz bu yerda asosiy maqsadimizni unutib qo'ymasligimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy maqsadingizni unutib qo'yish.

cards.ex: Our new assistant is really on the ball.
cards.exUz: Bizning yangi yordamchimiz haqiqatan ham sergak.
cards.uzDef: Tez tushunadigan va yaxshi ishlaydigan.

cards.ex: Don't get hung up on the small details.
cards.exUz: Kichik detallarga ortiqcha diqqat qaratmang.
cards.uzDef: Muhim bo'lmagan narsaga ortiqcha diqqat qaratish.

cards.ex: He's got a short fuse; be careful what you say.
cards.exUz: Uning jahli tez chiqadi, nima deyayotganingizga e'tibor bering.
cards.uzDef: Tezda jahli chiqadigan odam.

cards.ex: She has laser focus when she's working on a project.
cards.exUz: U loyihada ishlayotganida juda qattiq diqqat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli va aniq diqqat.

cards.ex: I'm so in the weeds with this project, I can't see the big picture.
cards.exUz: Men bu loyiha bilan juda ko'p tafsilotlarga botib qoldim, katta rasmni ko'ra olmayapman.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p tafsilotlarga botib qolgan.

cards.ex: I'm sorry, I lost my train of thought there.
cards.exUz: Kechirasiz, men o'sha yerda fikrimni yo'qotdim.
cards.uzDef: Gapirayotganda nima demoqchi ekanligini unutib qo'yish.

cards.ex: Come on, snap to it! We're running late.
cards.exUz: Kel, tez harakat qil! Biz kech qolyapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Tezda diqqatingizni jamlang va ishni boshlang.

cards.ex: He's easily rattled under pressure.
cards.exUz: U bosim ostida osongina asabiylashadi.
cards.uzDef: Osonlikcha asabiylasha oladigan yoki xavotirlana oladigan.

cards.ex: I got carried away with the shopping and spent too much.
cards.exUz: Men xarid qilishga berilib ketdim va juda ko'p pul sarfladim.
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari qiziqib ketish va o'lchovni unutish.

cards.ex: His obsessive focus on work is starting to worry his family.
cards.exUz: Uning ishga takroriy diqqati oilasini xavotirga solmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsaga haddan tashqari diqqat qaratish, g'oyaga aylanib ketishi.

cards.ex: She's very single-minded when she wants something.
cards.exUz: U biror narsani xohlaganida juda qat'iy bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat bitta maqsadga yo'naltirilgan va boshqa narsalarga e'tibor bermaydigan.

cards.ex: He's got a one-track mind; all he thinks about is football.
cards.exUz: Uning bir fikri bor; u faqat futbol haqida o'ylaydi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat bitta narsa haqida o'ylaydigan.

cards.ex: You need to get your act together and start studying.
cards.exUz: Siz o'zingizni tutishingiz va o'qishni boshlashingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z hayotingizni tartibga solish, yaxshi ishlashni boshlash.

cards.ex: I need to keep tabs on the project's progress.
cards.exUz: Men loyihaning rivojlanishini nazorat qilishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yoki kimnidir diqqat bilan kuzatib borish.

cards.ex: She gets easily flustered when she has to speak in public.
cards.exUz: U omma oldida gapirishga to'g'ri kelganda tezda asabiylashadi.
cards.uzDef: Tezda asabiylashadigan va chalkashib ketadigan.

cards.ex: She doesn't like being in the spotlight.
cards.exUz: U diqqat markazida bo'lishni yoqtirmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy diqqat markazida bo'lish.

cards.ex: I was riveted by the documentary.
cards.exUz: Men hujjatli filmga juda qiziqib qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirga juda qiziqib qolish va diqqatingizni to'liq qaratish.

cards.ex: I had a total brain fart and forgot her name.
cards.exUz: Mening miyam birdaniga ishlamay qoldi va uning ismini unutdim.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga nimanidir esdan chiqarib yuborish.

cards.ex: He gets hyper-focused when he's coding.
cards.exUz: U kod yozayotganda haddan tashqari diqqat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsaga haddan tashqari diqqat qaratish.

cards.ex: It was such a great movie, I couldn't take my eyes off the screen.
cards.exUz: Bu juda zo'r kino edi, men ekrandan ko'zimni uza olmadim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirga juda qiziqib, ko'zingizni uzolmaslik.

cards.ex: I have so many scattered thoughts, I can't concentrate.
cards.exUz: Menda juda ko'p tarqoq fikrlar bor, men diqqatimni jamlay olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Boshda tartibsiz va bog'liq bo'lmagan fikrlar.

cards.ex: I lost track of time reading that book.
cards.exUz: Men u kitobni o'qib vaqtni unutdim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir bilan shunchalik mashg'ul bo'lishki, vaqt qanday o'tayotganini sezmay qolish.

cards.ex: He's easily side-tracked during meetings.
cards.exUz: U yig'ilishlar davomida osongina chalg'iydi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni osongina boshqa narsaga burish.

cards.ex: When she's painting, she can focus like a laser.
cards.exUz: U rasm chizayotganda lazerdek diqqat qila oladi.
cards.uzDef: Juda aniq va kuchli diqqat.

cards.ex: I can't focus to save my life today; I'm too tired.
cards.exUz: Men bugun hech qanday yo'l bilan diqqatimni jamlay olmayman; men juda charchadim.
cards.term: can't focus to save my life
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday yo'l bilan diqqatni jamlay olmaslik.

cards.ex: After that exam, my brain is fried.
cards.exUz: O'sha imtihondan keyin mening miyam charchagan.
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari charchagan va diqqatni jamlay olmaydigan holat.

cards.ex: She was caught daydreaming in class again.
cards.exUz: U yana sinfda xayol surayotganida ushlandi.
cards.uzDef: Real hayotdan uzoqlashib, xayolda bo'lish.
